title: Lesson 7: The Memory Hierarchy & Cache Architecture — js-tools
desc: The memory wall, temporal and spatial locality, tag/index/offset address splitting, direct-mapped against set-associative caches with LRU, and multi-level AMAT. Verified with a real engine: walking an 8×8 array by row misses 25% while walking it by column misses 100%; a direct-mapped conflict trace misses 20/20 where 2-way misses only 2/20; 2-level AMAT comes out at 2.2 cycles; and write-back cuts DRAM writes from 10 to 1 at an identical hit rate. Also covers write policy with the dirty bit, and the 3C miss taxonomy.
